scope: Eight independent external motion-reference auditions, not a cinematic, runtime animation, or art redesign. At most two additional targeted replacements within ten returned samples.

owner_latest_assessment.finding: Adequate technical movement, extremely stiff and lacking personality. This supersedes the earlier agent 4.5 assessments; V6 is not an accepted performance.

output.native_fps: retain actual generator FPS; report it; do not interpolate or force 30fps

samples.name: Ribbon Glide: comfortable curiosity
samples.question: Does a quiet, generous effort-and-glide phrase feel alive rather than limp?
beats: her eyes notice a point offscreen right; a small interested head turn follows, then the chest joins
she inclines into a diagonal swim with one rounded tail stroke; elbows softly bend and relaxed palms sweep water backward, then recover closer to the body
she glides right with quiet confidence; the curved tail unfurls into fin follow-through, the hands float to comfortable asymmetric balance, and the curls settle later than the head
she eases to attentive buoyant stillness, a small warm smile and one natural blink; the tail catches up once without repeated bouncing
samples.end: Roshan is calmly attentive toward screen-right, hands relaxed and tail settled.
samples.path: pelvis starts at the opening position and travels about one quarter of the frame width right; no camera travel

samples.name: Playful Dolphin: delighted departure
samples.question: Can two contained propulsion beats express delight without frantic pumping?
beats: her eyes notice the same offscreen-right point; her brows lift slightly and her expression brightens before her shoulders commit

she gathers into a compact curved pose and opens into two quick, rounded tail efforts; one hand leads softly while the other balances, with moving elbows and wrists rather than straight outstretched arms
the effort resolves into a buoyant rightward glide and a pleased chest lift; the broad fin trails each tail beat without folding into a ribbon, and her curls lag the acceleration
she decelerates into the same attentive end position as the gentle version; one delighted smile resolves into calm availability
samples.end: Roshan is calmly attentive toward screen-right, hands relaxed and tail settled.
samples.path: same start, end, travel distance, scale and duration as RSW-01; vary effort and phrasing only

samples.name: Distracted explorer: look, reconsider, continue
samples.question: Does a change of thought read through gaze and body timing without pantomime?
beats: she begins a relaxed rightward swim with a small tail stroke and soft asymmetric arm recovery
her gaze catches an unseen detail slightly above-right; the eyes stop first, the head tilts after them, and the chest eases while the tail continues to trail
she makes one interested half-reach with the nearer hand, elbow leading and wrist following; the other hand gently sculls to balance, without detailed finger acting
a small satisfied smile says she has noticed enough; she lets the hand recover, redirects her gaze along her route and resumes one easy stroke into a quiet glide
samples.end: Roshan has resumed a relaxed screen-right glide with her attention ahead.
samples.path: modest rightward travel; a readable slowdown during inspection; do not add a visible object or second character

samples.name: Playful shallow bank: whole-body direction change
samples.question: Can shoulders, hands and tail cooperate in a turn without a rigid flying silhouette?
beats: she notices a point slightly lower-right and glances toward it with a little anticipatory smile
the head and chest lead one shallow bank toward that point; the nearer elbow bends and palm angles to steer, while the other arm opens a little for balance
her long tail follows the chest through a continuous curve and the fin arrives last; a rounded propulsion beat carries the bank into a gentle rightward glide, without rolling upside down
she levels out, glances ahead with pleased concentration and lets both hands, fin and curls recover at slightly different times
samples.end: Roshan is level in a gentle screen-right glide, with a relaxed smile and clear arm silhouette.
samples.path: one shallow downward-right arc, staying within the central safe area; no full spin, somersault or camera orbit

samples.name: Are we playing? impatience turns to eager motion
samples.register: bored to mildly impatient to delighted
samples.question: Is the personality transition readable silently without anger or a prolonged frozen face?
beats: she waits buoyantly, mildly bored; her eyes drift toward the viewer, eyelids soften and one shoulder settles while her hands hang comfortably, not rigidly
she raises one relaxed open palm a little, gives a small head tilt and lifts one brow as if asking whether play will begin; affectionate impatience, not scolding, no speech
her gaze suddenly catches the offscreen-right invitation; her eyes brighten and a genuine smile arrives before the chest opens and the tail gathers
she commits to two eager rounded tail strokes into a rightward glide; the raised hand returns naturally to swimming balance, wrists and elbows moving, with hair and fin finishing the gesture
samples.end: Roshan is eagerly gliding screen-right with bright eyes, a warm smile and relaxed recovering arms.
samples.path: supported waiting followed by short rightward travel; no angry pose, crossed-arm lecture or lip-synced dialogue

samples.name: Considerate arrival: ready to help
samples.question: Does deceleration make the hands available for useful action instead of leaving her in a flying pose?
beats: she looks toward an unseen destination at screen-right and inclines into a purposeful, quiet swim
one rounded tail effort carries her right; elbows flex and relaxed palms recover with water resistance, while the chest remains readable and the gaze stays on the destination
she decelerates with a gentle tail counter-sweep and small balancing palm motion; the torso becomes more upright as the tail catches up, without a sudden stop or size change
she offers one open hand toward the destination, looks from it to the unseen recipient, then waits with a small reassuring smile; no object appears and no contact is claimed
samples.end: Roshan waits upright and buoyant near screen-right, offering one relaxed hand and an attentive smile.
samples.path: same approximate travel distance as RSW-01; explicit slowing before the offer; no fabricated prop contact

samples.name: Ribbon cruise: two genuine three-second cycles
samples.question: Can a repeatable base swim retain breathing room and articulated arms without obvious resets?
beats: she eases from the opening hover into a comfortable diagonal screen-right swimming posture

perform the first complete three-second swim phrase against a gentle implied current: soft elbow-and-palm scull with a rounded torso-to-tail propulsion wave, followed by a longer glide and relaxed recovery; the broad fin follows late

perform the same full three-second phrase a second time continuously, passing through the same pose, stroke phase and speed at the join; do not reverse time, insert a hold, duplicate the rendered first cycle or reset her body
continue the natural glide and recovery beyond the second cycle so the editor has motion handles
samples.end: Roshan continues the easy screen-right-facing cruise with uninterrupted recovery motion.
samples.path: in-place against an implied current for extraction, stable average pelvis location and camera; local body wave and articulated arms must still read as swimming
samples.loop_note: Ask the generator to perform both cycles, not an editor to repeat the same video. Exact seams are a measured selection result, never guaranteed by prompt.

samples.name: Eager cruise: two genuine three-second cycles
samples.question: Can paired strokes feel eager but remain sustainable and pleasant when repeated?
beats: she eases from the opening hover into the same diagonal screen-right swimming posture as the gentle loop, with alert eyes and a small warm smile

perform one complete three-second phrase against a gentle implied current: two compact, rounded tail pulses with softly alternating elbow and palm recovery, then an easy buoyant glide; do not lock either arm straight

perform a second complete three-second phrase with the same effort pattern, pose phase and speed at the join; keep the gaze purposeful and the smile restrained, without repeating a large facial gag or reversing time
continue the glide and relaxed arm recovery naturally beyond the second cycle, letting fin and curls trail the body
samples.end: Roshan continues the lively screen-right-facing cruise with uninterrupted recovery motion.
samples.path: same framing, average pelvis position and viewing angle as RSW-07; in-place loop study, not a claim of measured world propulsion
samples.loop_note: Keep both native cycles. No boomerang, optical-flow seam repair, duplicated first-cycle footage or pose reset.
